name: – After § 2 – Am 33
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Clean Industrial Deal
part_text: 2a. Calls, in any case, for the implementation of the economically harmful policies of the Green Deal to be suspended, to enable a re-evaluation of their objectives and application; urges the Commission, moreover, to refrain from proposing a legislative initiative for an intermediate target of 90 % reductions in net greenhouse gas emissions by 2040;
